description: Durianpay legacy (orders/payments) API. Authentication: HTTP Basic — your Durianpay API key as the username with a blank password (Authorization: Basic base64(api_key + ':')). Set DURIANPAY_API_KEY.

env_var_specs.name: DURIANPAY_API_KEY
env_var_specs.description: Durianpay API key from Dashboard > Settings > API Keys (sandbox keys start dp_test_, live dp_live_). Sent as the Basic-auth username.

env_var_specs.name: DURIANPAY_API_PASSWORD
env_var_specs.description: Basic-auth password — leave unset; Durianpay uses a blank password.

tools.name: customers_patch-id
tools.description: Patch id. Required: id (default: 123). Optional: customer_ref_id, email, given_name (plus 1 more). Partial update.

params.name: id
params.description: Durianpay's Customer ID. Returned during payment/virtual account creation.

params.name: customer_ref_id
params.description: A unique reference ID from the merchant to identify the customer

params.name: email
params.description: The customer's email address. Should of the format jane.doe@gmail.com and should not contain any invalid special characters (¢,£,§,©,etc)

params.name: given_name
params.description: The customer's name

params.name: mobile
params.description: The customer's mobile number. Please ensure that the number follows Indonesia's phone number format : +62xxxxxxxxxx or 08xxxxxxxxxx.

tools.name: disbursements_fetch-by-id
tools.description: Retrieves a disbursement batch status and details (legacy). Returns completion signature when status is completed. Required: id.

params.name: id
params.description: Disbursement ID (dis_xxx)

tools.name: disbursements_submit
tools.description: Submits a disbursement batch (legacy). Supports idempotency via X-Idempotency-Key header. Query force_disburse=true bypasses approval; skip_validation=false validates recipient accounts. Required: items, name. Optional: force_disburse (default: false), skip_validation (default: false), description.

params.name: force_disburse
params.description: Disburse immediately without dashboard approval

params.name: skip_validation
params.description: Skip recipient bank-account validation

params.name: description
params.description: Batch description

params.name: items
params.description: Disbursement items

params.name: name
params.description: Batch name. Example: 'Payroll June'

tools.name: disbursements_approve_disbursement
tools.description: Approves a submitted disbursement batch (legacy). Use ignore_invalid=true query to approve while skipping invalid items. Required: id. Optional: ignore_invalid.

params.name: id
params.description: Disbursement ID (dis_xxx)

params.name: ignore_invalid
params.description: Approve while ignoring invalid items

tools.name: merchants_fetch-sub-account-fees
tools.description: The following endpoint retrieves fees of a single subaccount. Required: id (default: mer_123). Returns the MerchantsFetchSubAccountFeesResponse.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier of the subaccount, which can be taken from the response of Register...

tools.name: merchants_fetch-sub-account-fees-1
tools.description: The following endpoint retrieves balance of a single subaccount. Required: id (default: mer_1234). Optional: as_of (default: 2022-03-29T10:00:00.000+07:00). Returns the MerchantsFetchSubAccountFees1Response.

params.name: as_of
params.description: The specific date for which you wish to retrieve the closing balance. Defaults to current time if not specified. Please ensure that the value is in RFC3339 format. Example: '2022-03-29T10:00:00.000+07:00'

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier of the subaccount, which can be taken from the response of Register...

tools.name: merchants_fetch-subaccount
tools.description: This following endpoint retrieves the details of all created subaccounts. Optional: skip, limit. Returns the MerchantsFetchSubaccountResponse.

params.name: skip
params.description: The number of subaccount to be skipped. The default value is 0. This can be used for pagination. in combination with count

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of subaccount to be fetch. This can be used for pagination. in combination with the skip parameter

tools.name: merchants_register-sub-account
tools.description: The following endpoint registers a sub account under your master account. Required: email (default: organization_001@masterorg.biz), name (default: Awesome Sub Organization 001). Optional: ref_id (default: mer_123), subaccount_ownership (default: owned). Returns the new MerchantsRegisterSubAccountResponse.

params.name: email
params.description: Email of the sub account

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the sub account

params.name: ref_id
params.description: The unique identifier of Subaccount from the merchant

params.name: subaccount_ownership
params.description: Type of the subaccount, value can be either 'managed' or 'owned'

tools.name: merchants_update-sub-account-api
tools.description: The following endpoint updates subaccount's informations. Required: id (default: mer_123456). Optional: is_enabled, name, ref_id.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier of the subaccount, which can be taken from the response of Register...

params.name: is_enabled
params.description: Enable/Disable the respective subaccount

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the sub account

params.name: ref_id
params.description: The unique identifier of Subaccount from the merchant

tools.name: merchants_update-sub-account-fees
tools.description: This following endpoint allows master accounts to manage fees for subaccounts. Required: disbursement_fees, id (default: mer_x6EzWyIeVX3831). Optional: payment_fees. Returns the new MerchantsUpdateSubAccountFeesResponse.

params.name: disbursement-fees-fee
params.description: Amount of respective fee type

params.name: disbursement-fees-type
params.description: Fee type, possible values: flat, percentage

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier of the subaccount, which can be taken from the response of Register...

params.name: payment_fees
params.description: Details on which payment method will be assigned with the fee, including the fee configuration. Either fixed_fee or percentage_fee is mandatory; you must provide one of them, but providing both is not required, If both fee presents, The fee is calculated by accumulating percentage fee (applied to the total amount before the fee) to the fixed fee.

tools.name: orders_create
tools.description: The following endpoint creates an Order. Required: amount (default: 1000), currency (default: IDR), customer. Optional: admin_fee_method (default: excluded), description, expiry_date (default: 2026-09-29T10:00:00.000Z) (plus 5 more). Returns the new OrdersCreateResponse.

params.name: admin_fee_method
params.description: Used to specify if the transactional charges are to be included and paid by the merchant or customer. Possible Values: 'included' - Transaction Fee is paid by merchant 'excluded' - Transaction Fee is paid by customer

params.name: amount
params.description: The amount for which the Order was created. Example: '10000' or '10000.23' for amount with decimal value

params.name: currency
params.description: The currency associated with the Order's amount. Example: 'IDR'

params.name: customer-address-address-line
params.description: Address line

params.name: customer-address-city
params.description: City

params.name: customer-address-label
params.description: Label

params.name: customer-address-landmark
params.description: Landmark

params.name: customer-address-postal-code
params.description: Postal code

params.name: customer-address-receiver-name
params.description: Receiver name

params.name: customer-address-region
params.description: Region

params.name: customer-customer-ref-id
params.description: A unique reference ID from the merchant to identify the customer

params.name: customer-email
params.description: The customer's email address. Should of the format jane.doe@gmail.com and should not contain any invalid special characters (¢,£,§,©,etc)

params.name: customer-given-name
params.description: The customer's given name

params.name: customer-id
params.description: The customer ID from Durianpay

params.name: customer-middle-name
params.description: The customer's middle name

params.name: customer-mobile
params.description: The customer's mobile number. Please ensure that the number follows Indonesia's phone number format : +62xxxxxxxxxx or 08xxxxxxxxxx.

params.name: customer-sur-name
params.description: The customer's surname

params.name: description
params.description: String to store description of the order. Example: 'This order is delicate. Handle with Care!'

params.name: expiry_date
params.description: The time stamp at which the order will expire. Please ensure that the value is in RFC3339 format and the timezone is in GMT+7. Example: '2022-03-29T10:00:00.000Z'

params.name: is_payment_link
params.description: Whether Payment Link is to be generated. Example: true or false

params.name: items
params.description: Array of objects with each object including name, brand, category, sku, price, qty, total_price. mandatory to use BNPL and LINKAJA payment method

params.name: metadata
params.description: Key-Value pair that can be used to store additional information about the entity.

params.name: order_ref_id
params.description: The unique identifier of Order from the merchant. Example: 'INV/1/2021'

params.name: payment_option
params.description: The type of payment option with which order was created. Possible values: 'full_payment' or 'installment'

tools.name: orders_fetch
tools.description: The following endpoint retrieves the details of all Orders created. Optional: from, to, skip (plus 1 more). Returns array of OrdersFetchItem.

params.name: from
params.description: Timestamp (in YYYY-MM-DD format) from when the Orders should be fetched

params.name: to
params.description: Timestamp (in YYYY-MM-DD format) up till when Orders are to be fetched

params.name: skip
params.description: The number of orders to be skipped. The default value is 0. This can be used for pagination, in combination with count

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of orders to be fetched. Default value is 25. This can be used for pagination, in combination with the skip parameter

tools.name: orders_fetch-by-id
tools.description: The following endpoint retrieves the details of a single Order. Required: id (default: ord_A1B1C1D1234). Optional: expand (default: customer).

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier of the Order to be retrieved

params.name: expand
params.description: Used to retrieve additional information about the Order. Supported values are: customer, payments. Example: /orders/ord_A1B1C1D1234?expand=customer&expand=payments

tools.name: payments_charge
tools.description: Charges a payment against an order. The `type` field selects the payment method: VA (virtual account), EWALLET, QRIS, CARD, BNPL, ONLINE_BANKING, RETAIL_STORE. The `request` object shape varies per type; see docs.durianpay.id/reference for per-method bodies. Required: type (default: BNPL), request.

params.name: type
params.description: Type

params.name: request
params.description: The payload object for BNPL payment charge

tools.name: payments_create-virtual-account
tools.description: The following endpoint creates a new virtual account. Required: bank_code (default: PERMATA), customer, name (default: Dpay Jane Doe). Optional: account_suffix (default: 123456), amount (default: 20000), auto_disable_after_payment (default: false) (plus 4 more). Returns the new PaymentsCreateVirtualAccountResponse.

params.name: account_suffix
params.description: Account suffix for the Virtual Account. If not provided, a random suffix will be automatically generated for the virtual account number.

params.name: amount
params.description: Specify amount to be paid to va when is_closed=true. Example: '12000.12'

params.name: auto_disable_after_payment
params.description: Disable a reusable VA temporarily after a payment. Patch API can be used to enable it again after changing some parameters. Example: true or false

params.name: bank_code
params.description: The bank code for the Virtual Account. Supported Bank Codes: 'BRI', 'BCA', 'MANDIRI', 'PERMATA', 'CIMB', 'BNI', 'NOBU'

params.name: customer-customer-ref-id
params.description: A unique reference ID from the merchant to identify the customer

params.name: customer-email
params.description: Customer's email address in a valid email format (e.g., jane.doe@gmail.com) without invalid special characters (¢, £, §, ©, etc.)

params.name: customer-given-name
params.description: Customer's name

params.name: customer-id
params.description: Durianpay's customer ID

params.name: customer-mobile
params.description: Customer's mobile number in Indonesia's phone number format (+62xxxxxxxxxx or 08xxxxxxxxxx), with a length of 8 to 14 digits.

params.name: expiry_minutes
params.description: Number of minutes left till expiry from now. maximum: 15768000 minutes

params.name: is_closed
params.description: Whether account can accept open(any amount) or closed(specific amount). Example: true or false

params.name: is_reusable
params.description: Whether multiple payments can be used for a particular VA. Example: true or false

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the virtual account which will appear in ATM/Banking app. Example: 'John's Virtual Account'

params.name: va_ref_id
params.description: A reference ID which the merchant wants to use for a specific VA. Example: 'VA_XYZ_1234'

tools.name: payments_fetch-api
tools.description: The following endpoint retrieves the details of all Payments created. Optional: from, to, skip (plus 1 more).

params.name: from
params.description: Timestamp (in YYYY-MM-DD format) from when the Orders should be fetched

params.name: to
params.description: Timestamp (in YYYY-MM-DD format) up till when Orders are to be fetched

params.name: skip
params.description: The number of payments to be skipped. The default value is 0. This can be used for pagination, in combination with count

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of payments to be fetched. Default value is 25. This can be used for pagination, in combination with the skip parameter

tools.name: payments_fetch-by-id
tools.description: The following endpoint retrieves the details of a single payment. Required: id (default: pay_12345678). Optional: expand (default: order). Returns the PaymentsFetchByIdResponse.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier of the Payment to be retrieved

params.name: expand
params.description: Used to retrieve additional information about the Order. Supported values are: customer, payments. Example: /orders/ord_A1B1C1D1234?expand=customer&expand=payments

tools.name: payments_fetch-virtual-account
tools.description: The following endpoint retrieves the details of all Virtual Accounts created. Optional: from (default: 2024-09-01), to (default: 2024-09-09), skip (default: 0) (plus 1 more). Returns the PaymentsFetchVirtualAccountResponse.

params.name: from
params.description: Timestamp (in Unix format) from when the virtual accounts should be fetched

params.name: to
params.description: Timestamp (in Unix format) up till when virtual accounts are to be fetched

params.name: skip
params.description: The number of virtual accounts to be skipped. The default value is 0. This can be used for pagination, in combination with count

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of virtual accounts to be skipped. The default value is 0. This can be used for pagination, in combination with count

tools.name: payments_fetch-virtual-account-by-id
tools.description: The following endpoint retrieves the details of a single Virtual Account. Required: id (default: va_12345). Returns the PaymentsFetchVirtualAccountByIdResponse.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier of the Virtual Account to be retrieved

tools.name: payments_virtual-accounts-patch-by-id
tools.description: The following endpoint is used to override Expiry Time of a single Virtual Account. Required: id (default: va_1234). Optional: amount (default: 10000), expiry_minutes (default: 0), is_disabled (default: false) (plus 3 more). Returns the updated PaymentsVirtualAccountsPatchByIdResponse.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier of the Virtual Account to be retrieved

params.name: amount
params.description: Modify maximum amount which can be paid to a closed VA. Example: 10000

params.name: expiry_minutes
params.description: Number of minutes left till expiry from now. Set to 0 to expire VA Example: 10000

params.name: is_disabled
params.description: Modify enabling/disabling payments to a VA while still reserving it. Example: true

params.name: max_amount
params.description: Modify maximum amount which can be paid to an open VA. Example: 10000

params.name: min_amount
params.description: Modify minimum amount which can be paid to an open VA. Example: 10000

params.name: va_ref_id
params.description: Modify a reference ID which the merchant wants to use for a specific VA. Example: 'VA_XYZ_1234'

tools.name: payments_cancel_payment-api
tools.description: The following endpoint cancels a single Payment. Required: id (default: pay_123456). Returns the updated CancelPaymentApiResponse.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier of the Payment to be cancelled

tools.name: payments_status_check-payment
tools.description: The following endpoint checks the status of a single Payment. Required: id (default: pay_123456). Returns the StatusCheckPaymentResponse.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier of the Payment to be retrieved

tools.name: payments_verify_payments
tools.description: The following endpoint verifies the signature of payment callback. Required: id (default: pay_123456), verification_signature. Returns the new VerifyPaymentsResponse.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier of the Payment to be verified

params.name: verification_signature
params.description: Signature which has been provided to you while you successfully made a charge. Would have recived directly as a response to payments/charge API call OR as a payload on payment.completed webhook response

tools.name: refunds_create
tools.description: The following endpoint creates an Refund. Required: amount (default: 10000), payment_id (default: pay_IsL5nOCW4M2790), ref_id (default: abc). Optional: notes (default: rejected product). Returns the new RefundsCreateResponse.

params.name: notes
params.description: The refund note. Example: 'rejected product'

params.name: payment_id
params.description: Durianpay payment id used to create refund. Example: 'pay_ttqs62k99s'

params.name: ref_id
params.description: Merchant refund reference id. Example: 'ref_reference_123'

params.name: limit

tools.name: refunds_fetch-by-id
tools.description: The following endpoint retrieves the details of a single refund. Required: id (default: rfn_Ct2uKVFwts5080). Returns the RefundsFetchByIdResponse.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier of the Refund to be retrieved

tools.name: refunds_get-by-payment-id
tools.description: Refund Fetch by Payment ID. Required: id (default: pay_abcdefg1234). Returns array of RefundsGetByPaymentIdItem.
